summary: Backend-only test for iteration 5 (CORZAAR IMS extensions #5): (1) PDF certificate + share links, (2) session reminders in /me/notifications, (3) merchant insights, (4) wallet cashout to UPI (student request + admin approve/reject/paid). Wrote 23 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_features.py — 23/23 PASS against both http://localhost:8001 and the public URL https://corzaar-staging.preview.emergentagent.com. Regression: iteration_4 suite still 14/14 pass. All 9 declared feature bullets verified end-to-end. PDF: returns 200 with content-type application/pdf, %PDF magic header + Content-Disposition attachment with CZ-CERT-* filename via both Bearer and ?auth= token; 404 pre-completion; 401/403 unauth. Share: returns certificate_url, pdf_url (ends .pdf), linkedin (contains 'www.linkedin.com/sharing'), twitter (twitter.com/intent/tweet), whatsapp (wa.me); 404 pre-completion. Reminders: student with active enrollment sees a kind='reminder' item whose body includes the course title and today's ISO date; merchant/non-student callers never see reminders. Insights: rating_trend[] items have {week, average, count} bucketed by ISO week-start; top_courses ≤ 5, includes {id,title,rating,reviews_count,students}; curriculum_dropoff per course has items[]:{item,completed,pct} with correct math (verified Alpha 2/2=100%, Beta 1/2=50%, Gamma 0/2=0%). Merchant-only (student and admin both get 403). Cashout: min ₹500 validated (100 rejected), amount ≤ wallet enforced (5000 rejected with balance≈600), upi_id must contain '@' (rejected), non-student can't request (403). Successful cashout returns status=pending, decrements wallet immediately, inserts 'Cashout requested' audit entry + notification. GET /me/cashouts scoped to caller; GET /admin/cashouts admin-only (403 for student). Admin action: rejected → refunds wallet + inserts notification, subsequent action on same cashout → 400 'already resolved'; paid → wallet stays deducted, reference stored, notification fired, audit log has both 'Cashout requested' and 'Cashout paid' entries for the same target_id. Non-admin action returns 403. Regression: Stripe hosted checkout URL (checkout.stripe.com) via POST /api/payments/checkout; referrals/wallet endpoint intact (code=REF*, reward=200); batch auto-sessions still produces 4 sessions for Mon/Wed pattern in 2-week window; admin payouts ledger OK; certificate HTML still works; reviews POST /api/reviews (courses target) still works.

minor.issue: Order of validation errors: min-amount → balance → UPI-format. So if wallet is empty and user sends amount=100 the response is 'Minimum cashout is ₹500' rather than the more informative 'insufficient balance'. Non-blocking, but consider ordering balance check earlier for UX or returning a structured errors[] with all failed rules. See server.py:1208-1215.

The status regex allows 'approved' but there is no side-effect for it — it just marks the row as 'approved' without notification/audit differentiation. If 'approved' is meant to be an intermediate state before 'paid', add a notification and allow paid/rejected transitions from 'approved' (currently only paid/rejected are considered terminal in the 'already resolved' guard, so 'approved' can still move to paid/rejected — this is fine, but the UX distinction should be documented). See server.py:1235-1251.

_session_reminders enumerates every active batch for every course the student is enrolled in and every session inside. On large data this scales O(batches × sessions). Consider a Mongo aggregation with {sessions.date: {$in: [today, tomorrow]}} filter. Non-blocking for MVP. See server.py:1255-1273.

rating_trend groups by ISO week-start using UTC date only — reviews created near midnight IST can bucket into the previous week. Consider using the merchant's timezone or documenting UTC. Non-blocking. See server.py:1178-1183.

Wallet is decremented via $inc BEFORE the cashout is inserted, but there is no transaction. If the insert fails after the $inc, wallet_balance is silently lost. Wrap in a Motor client_session().start_transaction() or reverse the order and rollback on insert failure. See server.py:1217-1219.

action_items: Consider making cashout validation return the most useful error first (balance vs min) or return a structured errors[] object.
Document or implement side-effects for the 'approved' cashout intermediate state (notification, audit) since the endpoint accepts it via the status regex.
Add a MongoDB transaction (or compensating update) around cashout create so a failed insert doesn't lose wallet balance.
Consider timezone-aware week bucketing for merchant rating_trend, or explicitly declare UTC in the API contract.
Optional: aggregate _session_reminders in Mongo for O(1) query with growth.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1217-1219 — race between $inc(wallet_balance) and insert_one(cashouts). Wrap in a transaction to guarantee atomicity.

server.py:1235-1251 — 'approved' status is accepted by the Query regex but has no dedicated notification/audit copy; UI cannot distinguish an approved-but-not-yet-paid row from a plain pending one via notifications.

server.py:1158 — cert_url is built from APP_PAYMENT_RETURN_URL.split('/api/')[0] which returns the full URL when '/api/' is not present. If the env var is later configured without '/api/' the split becomes a no-op silently. Consider a dedicated APP_PUBLIC_URL env.

server.py:1183 — trend uses `datetime.fromisoformat(r['created_at'].replace('Z','+00:00'))` — safe, but the created_at is written with datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() and it may or may not carry the 'Z' suffix. Add a small parser helper to avoid subtle failures.

server.py:1265-1272 — reminder id is deterministic (f'rem-{sess_id}-today'), so if the same session shows up in two batches (unlikely) the notification duplicates. Also, kind='reminder' items are prepended each call — clients that persist server-supplied notification ids may see duplicates across polling calls. Fine for MVP; consider a 'transient' flag.
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed data with random 10-digit mobiles per test: multiple students (PDF/Share/Rem/Ins/Cash*/Reg*), merchants with auto-created institutes, courses (TEST_Reminder_Course, TEST_Insight_Course, TEST_Reg_Batch, TEST_Reg_Review), coupons (REMFREE*, INSFREE*, REGREV*), a full-weekday batch for today's reminder test, 3 free-course referral enrollments per cashout test to seed ₹600 wallet, cashouts in states pending/rejected/paid, notifications and audit-log entries. All isolated by UUID-based mobiles and course-scoped coupons.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `EXPO_BACKEND_URL=https://corzaar-staging.preview.emergentagent.com pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_features.py -v`. Wallet seed helper `_seed_wallet(student, target)` uses REFERRAL_REWARD (₹200) × N free-course enrollments. Reviews path is POST /api/reviews with body {target_type,target_id,rating,text}. Stripe checkout is a two-step flow: POST /api/enrollments (returns enrollment) → POST /api/payments/checkout {enrollment_id} → returns checkout_url. Audit endpoint is /api/admin/audit-logs (plural). Reminder test creates a full-weekday batch (Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun) starting today so today's date is always a session date. Cashout tests all validate wallet_balance via GET /api/me/referrals (which returns wallet_balance).
rca_of_issue: No unresolved issues. All 9 declared feature bullets pass: (1) certificate.pdf → 200 application/pdf with %PDF header, Bearer + ?auth= both accepted, 404 pre-completion; (2) /share returns all 5 channels with proper linkedin.com/sharing URL; (3) reminder items with kind='reminder' appear only for students with a session today/tomorrow, non-students see none; (4) merchant/insights returns 3 sections with correct shape + math and 403 for non-merchant; (5) cashout POST validates min ≥500, amount ≤ wallet, UPI contains '@', decrements wallet + creates notif + audit on success; (6) /me/cashouts is caller-scoped, /admin/cashouts admin-only; (7) admin action status=paid stores reference + notif + audit, already-resolved → 400; (8) end-to-end wallet: 500 request → wallet drops 500 → reject → wallet restored; new request → paid → wallet stays deducted, audit has both 'Cashout requested' and 'Cashout paid' entries for same cashout id; (9) iteration_4 regression pass (Stripe checkout URL, coupons+referrals, reviews, batches auto-sessions, admin payouts ledger, certificate HTML).
